answer: Archival provenance chains anchor each agent identity to a unique, timestamped ledger entry, so a sybil must fabricate a divergent history that peers can trace as violet thread through the record. Honest agents wander across the river of transactions leaving immutable citations, and colluders cannot retroactively splice their forged identities into that shared chain without. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
